Are you passionate about bioanalytical operational aspects of clinical trials? Do you have experience within clinical trial planning, timelines, and working with special labs?

If so, now is your chance to join Ascendis Pharma as our new employee in Bioanalytical Operations.

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients' lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and Oncology portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

We are seeking a passionate Professional to join our growing team. As a key member of the Ascendis Pharma team, you will play a crucial role in all bioanalytical operational aspects of clinical trial conduct. This is an exciting opportunity to work in a fast-paced environment, collaborate with cross-functional, global teams working together to achieve extraordinary results.

You will be joining the Bioanalytical Operational Team in the Clinical Pharmacology & Bioanalysis area, based in our office in Hellerup. We are a well-functioning area, we treat each other with respect, and we never forget to bring a sense of humor to work. You will report directly to Vice President Britta Bysted.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• Responsible for all bioanalytical operational aspects of clinical trial conduct on assigned projects according to trial timelines and priorities

• Manage logistics and timelines for execution of bioanalytical sample analysis, from sample collection and processing, shipment, testing, data transfer, including sample tracking, reconciliation, and final sample disposition

• Represent our area in the cross-functional trial teams, working closely with clinical operations, data management, clinical trial supplies among others

• Support bioanalytical outsourcing activities in close collaboration with outsourcing department, including study-specific contract set-up, management of POs and invoices, and relevant communication with vendors

• Provide input, review and approval, where applicable of relevant sections in study-related documents i.e., protocols/ICFs, data transfer specifications, central lab SOWs, laboratory manuals, SOPs, assay performance, bioanalytical reports, etc

• Contribute to development and continuous improvement of bioanalytical operational processes and supporting documentation

Qualifications and Skills:

You hold a bachelor degree in natural science or are trained as a nurse, laboratory technician, or similar with at least 5 years' experience with pharmaceutical drug development. Perhaps you have worked as a sample manager, clinical trial associate, clinical trial manager, or in similar roles.

Furthermore, you have:

• Strong insights into GCP

• Experience with operational aspects of planning and executing clinical trials, and related documentation

• Proven track record in working with external vendors, e.g., special and central laboratories

• Strong IT skills

Key competencies:

To succeed in this role, we expect you to be able to work independently, be open-minded, flexible, supportive, and detail oriented.

You are a strong team player with a flair for logistics, and you enjoy being organized and systematic in your daily work. You thrive in an informal, open environment where innovation and change are key. You are comfortable navigating cross-functional collaborations and driving alignment among stakeholders.

Travel: 3-7 days per year.

Office: Tuborg Boulevard 12, Hellerup, Denmark

Apply now.

We evaluate applications when received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that we conduct interviews on a rolling basis and reserve the right to remove the job posting at any time.

To ensure your application is reviewed, please submit it through the specified platform - applications sent by email or other channels will not be evaluated.

For more details about the position or the company, please contact Britta Bysted, Vice President of Clinical Pharmacology & Bioanalysis, bvb@ascendispharma.com.

You can learn more about Ascendis by visiting our website www.ascendispharma.com

Applications must be submitted in English and will be treated confidentially.

_Do you want to join a global leader in renewable energy infrastructure investments? If so, CIP Fund Solutions is looking for an Associate to join our skilled and dedicated Valuation team in Copenhagen.

As part of the final investment decision process, you will be responsible for engaging with the investment teams, providing detailed financial model assumption reviews to ensure consistent and well-documented business cases, and being accountable for delivering key inputs such as discount rate assumptions to become a trusted business partner, supporting our global investment strategy for the investments and funds managed by CIP.

You have a very strong theoretical understanding of complex valuation methodologies and can present complex financial and valuation methods simply and clearly to CIP's senior management.

We look for the following in a candidate:

• The ability to navigate and thrive in a high-intensity environment

• Well-developed interpersonal and communication skills

• Hands-on experience using AI tools to enhance analysis and modelling, with the judgment to verify outputs and protect confidential information

• Used to working in an international setting

• Fluent in English

About MITS Industries

MITS Industries is establishing an R&D and design site in Copenhagen focused on advanced RF systems, signal intelligence, aerospace technologies, and mission-critical product development.

The site will build core engineering capabilities in RF and microwave hardware, antenna systems, RF testing and characterization, rugged mechanical integration, and the industrialization of complex radio-electronic systems.

The Copenhagen team will work closely with strategic partners and engineering teams across Europe, playing a leading role in the development, validation, and industrialization of advanced technologies for defense, aerospace, and other demanding applications.

One of the initial focus areas will be the development of an advanced aerospace signal intelligence product platform. The work will cover RF and system architecture, antenna system design, signal acquisition, embedded control, laboratory validation, mechanical integration, integration with the satellite platform, and preparation for production and field deployment.

The ambition is to build a strong technical design site capable of taking complex RF products, modules, and platforms from architecture and detailed design through prototyping, testing, validation, industrialization, and deployment.

About the role

MITS Industries is looking for a Senior Systems Engineer, RF Systems to join the core Copenhagen R&D team and help build the site’s systems engineering capability for advanced RF, aerospace, and signal-intelligence products. You will translate product, mission, and stakeholder needs into clear functional, performance, and parametric requirements, system architectures, subsystem allocation, interface definitions, integration strategies, and verification plans. The work covers requirements decomposition and traceability, system performance budgeting, interface management, technical risk analysis, design reviews, integration planning, and system level verification and validation. You will work closely with RF and microwave hardware engineers, antenna systems engineers, embedded and control engineers, signal-processing engineers, RF test and characterization engineers, mechanical design engineers, project managers, and partner engineering teams. You will ensure that requirements, design decisions, implementation, integration, testing, and validation remain connected throughout the development lifecycle. The role requires strong RF system understanding, structured systems-engineering expertise, technical ownership, and a hands-on integration mindset. Working with technical leadership, you will turn product and architectural intent into an executable, traceable, and verifiable engineering baseline and help carry the product through integration, qualification, and deployment.

Key responsibilities

• Translate product, mission, and stakeholder needs into clear functional, performance, parametric, interface, environmental, and verification requirements.

• Develop and maintain the functional and physical system architecture, allocate requirements to subsystems, and define key technical trade-offs.

• Establish and maintain system performance budgets and constraints covering RF performance, timing and synchronization, data flow, power, thermal performance, mass, and platform interfaces.

• Define and maintain system requirements, subsystem requirements, interface control documentation, acceptance criteria, and verification logic.

• Align RF subsystem requirements, including frequency coverage, sensitivity, selectivity, dynamic range, noise figure, linearity, phase noise, spurious responses, channel isolation, and interference resilience.

• Define antenna-system requirements covering frequency coverage, antenna gain, polarization, radiation-pattern characteristics, isolation between antenna channels, placement, and platform integration.

• Define embedded control, data acquisition, timing, synchronization, diagnostics, logging, networking, and system-monitoring requirements.

• Coordinate mechanical and platform requirements covering dimensions, mass, thermal management, connectors, cabling, grounding, shielding, mounting, environmental constraints, and serviceability.

• Work with RF test and characterization engineers to define measurable acceptance criteria, calibration needs, verification methods, test coverage, and required evidence.

• Prepare and maintain system requirements specifications, interface-control documents, system budgets, integration plans, verification plans, compliance matrices, and technical decision records.

• Lead system integration planning and support prototype bring-up, laboratory validation, qualification, and field-test preparation.

• Identify system-level risks, interface conflicts, missing requirements, invalid assumptions, and integration blockers, and drive their resolution.

• Facilitate cross-functional technical alignment between engineering disciplines, technical leadership, manufacturing partners, and partner engineering teams.

• Support requirements reviews, system design reviews, integration reviews, test readiness reviews, and milestone decisions.

• Maintain traceability between stakeholder needs, requirements, design decisions, implementation, verification results, and acceptance evidence.

• Help establish systems-engineering methods, documentation practices, requirements-management workflows, and technical-review processes for future MITS Industries development programs.

Required qualifications and experience

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in electrical or electronic engineering, telecommunications, systems engineering, aerospace engineering, applied physics, or a related field.

• 6+ years of professional experience in systems engineering for complex RF, electronic, aerospace, or other mission-critical systems.

• Strong understanding of RF systems, including receiver architectures, RF signal paths, antenna interfaces, signal acquisition, data conversion, embedded control, timing and synchronization, calibration, and system validation.

• Proven experience translating product, mission, and stakeholder needs into functional, performance, parametric, interface, environmental, and verification requirements.

• Experience developing functional and physical system architectures, decomposing systems into subsystems, allocating requirements, and defining interfaces and technical trade-offs.

• Experience establishing and maintaining system performance budgets and constraints covering RF performance, timing and synchronization, data flow, power, thermal performance, mass, and platform interfaces.

• Strong understanding of requirements decomposition, traceability, acceptance criteria, and verification methods, including analysis, inspection, demonstration, and testing.

• Experience preparing and maintaining system requirements specifications, interface-control documents, integration plans, verification plans, compliance matrices, and technical decision records.

• Practical experience with requirements-management and traceability tools such as IBM Engineering DOORS, Jama Connect, Polarion, or equivalent.

• Experience working with cross-functional engineering teams covering RF and microwave hardware, antennas, embedded systems, signal processing, mechanical design, test, manufacturing, and system integration.

• Ability to evaluate technical trade-offs across RF performance, embedded implementation, mechanical and thermal constraints, testability, manufacturability, reliability, and operational use.

• Hands-on experience with prototype integration, laboratory validation, system-level debugging, and troubleshooting of complex multidisciplinary systems.

• Experience identifying and managing system-level risks, interface conflicts, assumptions, technical dependencies, and integration blockers. Strong technical communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to align senior engineers and drive decisions across engineering disciplines.

Nice to have

• Experience with signal-intelligence, direction-finding, spectrum-monitoring, or radio-surveillance systems.

• Experience with SDR-based systems and high-throughput RF data acquisition.

• Experience with broadband, multiband, coherent, or multichannel receiver systems.

• Experience with Model-Based Systems Engineering, SysML, and tools such as Cameo Systems Modeler, Enterprise Architect, or equivalent.

• Experience establishing and maintaining controlled system baselines, including requirements, interfaces, verification status, configuration, and engineering changes.

• Experience with engineering analysis, data processing, or system modelling using MATLAB, Python, or equivalent.

• Experience with field integration, testing, calibration, and deployment of complex RF or aerospace systems.

• Experience working on aerospace, mission-critical, ruggedized, or internationally distributed engineering programs.

Success in the first 6 months

• Establish the initial system requirements baseline, subsystem allocation, interface definitions, and performance budgets for the assigned product scope.

• Create a clear technical decomposition across RF and microwave hardware, antenna systems, embedded control, signal processing, mechanical design, test, and system integration.

• Define the integration, verification, and validation approach for the initial prototype or subsystem, including acceptance criteria, traceability, and required evidence.

• Identify unclear interfaces, missing requirements, technical assumptions, and system-level risks early, and drive practical resolution actions. Support prototype integration, bring-up, and laboratory validation with structured system-level analysis, troubleshooting, and verification evidence.

• Establish repeatable systems-engineering practices, documentation templates, requirements-management workflows, and technical-review processes for future development programs.

You’ll enjoy the freedom of flexible working practices to complement your lifestyle and help you perform at your very best.

**Do you want to join the team?

**If you are ambitious and want to help set the direction for our clients, then do not hesitate to apply for the job by clicking the button below.

Any questions? Contact hiring manager Mette Riis Bach at mette.bach@accrease.com or +45 3139 4022

**Description

**Factbird helps manufacturers see what’s really happening on their production lines. Our lightweight hardware products are installed directly on the production lines and collect data from the machines without the need of heavy consultant implementations. Our hardware turn data into real-time insight on production output, downtime, and efficiency, so the people on the factory floor and in management can make better decisions. Today we have 300+ customers across Europe and US, and with a recent partnership with Verdane, we are looking to scale our efforts even further.

Coming this far has only been possible by relentlessly understanding our customer’s pains and needs and turning that into solutions that generate real-world value in the manufacturers’ day-to-day. As our customer base grows, some of the most valuable conversations we can have are with the manufacturers already using Factbird every day: helping them get more out of the platform, showing them the value they’ve achieved, and giving them good reasons to tell others about it. That’s why we’re hiring our first dedicated Customer Marketing Manager.

You’ll join our marketing team and work side by side with our Product Marketing Director, the Marketing team and Customer Success to support building programs that turn customers into long-term partners and advocates.

**The role

**As Customer Marketing Manager, you’ll own marketing for everyone who is already a Factbird customer; from their first weeks on the platform to their renewal and beyond. You’ll design and run the lifecycle, expansion, and advocacy programs that help customers adopt more of Factbird, see the value they’re getting, and grow with us.

This is also a data-informed role. You’ll use product usage data from Mixpanel and customer data in HubSpot to understand how accounts actually use Factbird and turn those insights into communication that’s relevant and well-timed. You’ll also make sure what customers tell us reaches product marketing to support campaigns and positioning.

You’ll report to Frederik Krogtoft, Product Marketing Director, and be part of the Marketing team based in Copenhagen.

**What You'll Do

**Lifecycle, adoption & education

• Build and run onboarding journeys in HubSpot, email flows and welcome packs, that help new customers get up and running quickly.

• Plan feature-adoption campaigns based on Mixpanel usage data, targeted at the accounts that will benefit most.

• Promote professional services and training to under-engaged accounts.

• Build and maintain the Factbird Academy, our customer knowledge base.

Expansion & account-based marketing

• Run campaigns that communicate our roadmap and the value of new products to existing customers.

• Build upsell and cross-sell nurture flows.

• Produce content for ABM campaigns, from micro-vertical programs to 1:1 account campaigns and source the customer data these programs need.

Customer advocacy & reviews

• Build and run our customer referral program.

• Manage the pipeline of customer quotes and logo permissions.

• Source customers for case studies (production is handled by our Content team) and recruit customer speakers for events.

• Run internal and external campaigns to earn high ratings and rankings on review sites such as G2 and Capterra.

Customer insights, voice of the customer & retention

• Turn product usage (Mixpanel) and CRM (HubSpot) data into customer insights that feed our campaigns and positioning.

• Collect customer feedback, report on NPS, and route insights to Product Marketing

• Partner with Customer Success and own the CSAT and NPS survey cadence and make sure responses get the right follow-up.

• Partner with Customer Success on customer health reporting and set up campaign triggers for accounts that show churn risk.

**What We're Looking For

**We’re looking for a hands-on customer marketer who is equally at home with data and with words. You build programs from scratch rather than waiting for a playbook; you work easily across teams, and you always make the customer the hero of the story.

The Ideal Background

• 3–5 years of experience in customer and/or product marketing, ideally in a B2B SaaS company.

• Hands-on experience building email journeys and segmentation in HubSpot.

• A track record in customer advocacy, such as references, case studies, referral programs, or review-site campaigns (G2, Capterra).

• Experience with account-based marketing.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

**Why Factbird?

**People are at the heart of everything we build. We believe great products come from empowered teams — and we work hard to create an environment where you can do your best work and have space for life beyond it.

Here’s what you can look forward to:

• Flexible working hours: We trust you to manage your time. Life isn’t one-size-fits-all, and neither is work.

• Competitive salary: We offer compensation that reflects your skills, experience, and impact.

• Internet reimbursement: Stay connected and productive, wherever you choose to work from.

• Thoughtful, human onboarding: We’ll support you step by step, giving you the context, tools, and guidance you need to feel confident from day one.

• A career path that grows with you: Through bi-yearly Individual Development Plan conversations, we’ll work together to shape a career journey that fits your ambitions.

• Company-wide kickoffs & team days: We regularly come together across teams and regions to connect, celebrate, and align on what’s next.

• A global, inclusive culture: We’re proud of our diverse backgrounds and perspectives — and we actively celebrate them in how we work and collaborate.

**We’d love to hear from you

**If this role feels like a match, we’d be excited to hear from you and explore how you could help shape the future of data collection and production monitoring at Factbird.

And if someone in your network comes to mind who might be a great fit — feel free to share this opportunity with them.

Have questions? You can always reach out at **khma@factbird.com

**

jobs.description:
Your impact begins here

As Sr. DOL Engagement Manager, you will set the strategic direction for how Novo engages Digital Opinion Leaders (DOLs) across our global portfolio today and in the future. You will work closely with global colleagues in Product & Portfolio Strategy as well as International Operations and US Operations to drive planning and successful execution of DOL Engagement priorities with strong business impact.

What you’ll bring

**Essential

**

• Master’s degree in science, Marketing, Business Administration, DOL Project Management or a related field.

• 5–8 years of experience with DOL engagement, strategic scientific communication, marketing strategy and execution.

• A proven track record of leading complex projects with functional impact, preferably with informal leadership

• Strong strategic planning skills, with the ability to turn business priorities into DOL engagement plans and see them through across campaigns and events.

• Excellent stakeholder management communication and presentation skills, including with senior leaders and external partners.

• The ability to make informed decisions in complex, fast-changing situations, and to stay focused when priorities shift.

What you’ll do

You will become part of a team shaping how we strategically work with DOL engagement in Novo.

• Set clear strategic priorities and KPIs for global DOL engagement, and drive planning and execution against them.

• Build scalable frameworks and lean processes that make DOL engagement easier to repeat across assets and markets.

• Lead projects, timelines and budgets, monitor spend against financial targets and adapt when priorities change.

• Coordinate agencies, vendors and internal teams to deliver high-quality engagements, and use performance data and feedback to keep improving.

• Build close partnerships with stakeholders across PPS, International Operations and US Operations to align objectives and expectations.

• Share DOL engagement activities and their business impact through internal channels such as newsletters, SharePoint and webinars.

• Meet compliance and quality requirements (QMS) that apply to the role.

Who you’ll work with

You will join Congresses & DOL Engagement in Product & Portfolio Strategy (PPS) team based out of Soborg, Denmark.

Your closest partners will be leaders and colleagues across PPS, International Operations and US Operations, at global, regional and affiliate level, including Global Public Affairs and Corporate Legal. Externally, you will work with agencies, vendors and thought leaders.

As this is a global role, you should expect to work with different time zones and have around 15–20 days of travel per year. Decisions in this role are often complex and need alignment with senior stakeholders, so you are expected to bring clarity, speak up early and keep work moving.

What you can expect here

We expect you to come up with new ideas, take initiative and drive your priorities, in a role where the work is varied, complex and often without precedence. You will be trusted to perform, supported to grow, and encouraged to make your voice heard. Once a decision is made, we move forward together.

You will build new skills by working across Novo’s global, regional and affiliate teams, and by learning from the experts you partner with.

What we offer

At Novo Nordisk, you’ll join a global healthcare company with a unique culture and strong results. We offer continuous learning, career development, and benefits tailored to your life and career stage.

Salary:  For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 742,600.00 to 1,091,600.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area, and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

Start now

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to shape how Novo engages Digital Opinion Leaders worldwide, apply for the Sr. DOL Engagement Manager role by 18th Nov, 2026.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

**Job Description

**SOUNDBOKS is an innovative tech company and aspiring lifestyle brand. You may have seen us at a music festival, street party, or your friend’s celebration (think: private events combining festival-grade sound with beat-enhancing lights) where special moments are turned into memories. We create the loudest, most durable, and arguably coolest Bluetooth speakers and audio reactive lights on the market.

At SOUNDBOKS, trust and community go hand in hand. People are encouraged to take ownership of their work while knowing they have the support of the team behind them. Voices are heard, ideas are welcomed, and collaboration is what pushes us forward.

This is more than a job - it’s a community where people care about each other, celebrate together, and share the energy of creating something meaningful. Life at SOUNDBOKS is bold, fast, and full of passion - for the product, for the mission, and for showing up as your true self. With 70 team members, this is a place where you can do your best work and truly belong.

ROLE AUDIO ENGINEER

TEAM PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT

HOURS FULL TIME

LOCATION COPENHAGEN, DENMARK

START DATE OCTOBER 2026 or ASAP

The Product Development team at SOUNDBOKS is the group responsible for the exciting product journey, taking every step of the development process toward and into mass production. In it’s heartbeat you’ll find collaborative and self-driven team members with a large cross-discipline understanding tied to ownership. They are there to make a difference - for the products, the team and the SOUNDBOKS customers as a whole.

As our Audio Engineer, you'll explore new ways to improve the audio experience across SOUNDBOKS products by combining signal processing, system simulation, and engineering insight. Working closely with the Acoustics, Hardware, and Firmware teams, you'll help shape the technologies behind our next generation of speakers.

Okay, let’s make things a little more concrete. Here’s what we expect your daily life to look like:

**Audio System Development

**

• Develop audio concepts and proof-of-concepts at a system level.

• Explore new approaches to improve audio performance across products.

• Collaborate with the Acoustics, Hardware, and Firmware teams during concept development.

**Signal Processing & Simulation

**

• Perform advanced signal processing simulations with a focus on sound pressure level (SPL), sound quality, and system efficiency.

• Simulate the interaction between acoustics, amplifiers, electronics, and battery performance.

• Evaluate and develop signal processing algorithms to improve overall product audio performance.

**System Performance & Collaboration

**

• Work closely across the entire Product Development team in order to evolve and improve the audio performance across our future product portfolio.

• Apply signal processing methodologies to improve sound pressure, sound quality, and battery performance.

**Job Requirements

****In order to become a success in this role, we believe that your profile should be aligned with the bullets listed below. However, we acknowledge that success can take many forms, so please do apply even if you don’t tick all the boxes.

**

• You hold a BSc or higher in Audio Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Acoustics, or a related engineering field.

• You've designed and simulated audio systems, ideally loudspeakers, and know your way around signal processing for audio.

• You're comfortable using simulations and measurements to test ideas, challenge assumptions, and make better engineering decisions.

• It’ll be considered a plus if you have experience working with loudspeaker design, transducers, enclosure design, or audio electronics.

• You get excited by solving difficult audio problems and finding smarter ways to improve performance.

• You're naturally curious, love experimenting, and enjoy digging into the details until things sound and work better.

• You take ownership of your work and enjoy bouncing ideas around with people who know more than you in their field.

• You're drawn to what SOUNDBOKS is building and are excited to be a part of the journey!

Intrigued? At SOUNDBOKS you’ll find yourself a part of a community. We realize that growth is a process and we don’t expect you to go through it alone. Actually, we guarantee that you won’t have to. We work together in order to work smarter, we inspire each other to be better, and we never forget that every member of the team is responsible for our success.

So, if you’re tired of all of the noise in the job market, we’d love to hear from you. This may be the coolest job you ever have.

**

**

• A collaborative work environment where your input is not only valued but often implemented within hours

**Your impact begins here

**We are seeking a talented and motivated colleague to join our Biophysics and Injectable Formulation team. In this role, you will collaborate across disciplines to accelerate research and help design the next generation of pharmaceuticals that meet unmet patient needs.

As Senior Research Scientist, you will use biophysics to help decide which drug molecules move forward and how they become stable injectable treatments. You will design experiments, recommend molecule designs and drive formulation development towards clinical development. Working with colleagues across biology, chemistry and recombinant technologies, you will bring automation, high-throughput screening and AI into daily research, helping design the next generation of treatments for unmet patient needs. Your work helps us respond to complex, cross-regional needs with clarity and pace, so Novo can move closer to its purpose of driving change for lasting health.

**What You’ll Bring

**A PhD in biochemistry, biophysics or a related field, preferably combined with at least two years of additional relevant experience and strong expertise in biomolecular science.

• Strong collaboration and networking skills, with demonstrated ability to contribute in matrix project teams.

• Excellent analytical skills and the ability to independently draw and communicate clear conclusions from complex data.

• Excellent written and spoken English, strong communication skills and a team-first approach to solving complex challenges.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**

• Laboratory experience with assay development in high-throughput formats and automation.

• Experience with protein engineering and/or formulation development.

• Experience with NMR spectroscopy for characterisation of proteins and peptides.

**What You’ll Do

**You will apply biophysical characterisation to find fit-for-purpose drug molecules and develop stable injectable formulations, across peptides, proteins, monoclonal antibodies and multi-specific formats. You will have a high level of independence and flexibility within the research project framework.

• Design biophysical characterisation and screening experiments that meet project needs, and recommend molecule design and modality choices for optimal developability in the discovery phase.

• Drive formulation development to enable progression towards clinical development.

• Use state-of-the-art techniques such as light scattering, chromatography, SAXS, nanoDSF, FIDA and NMR to assess drug-product risks in research projects.

• Drive the implementation of new technologies and ways of working in the department.

• Apply automation and high-throughput screening to enable efficient characterisation and selection of molecules with optimal developability profiles.

• Explore and apply digitalisation and AI approaches that bridge experimental science and digital tools to address research project needs.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join Biophysics and Injectable Formulation, a research area of three departments that share biophysical characterisation of biomolecules and injectable formulation development as core tasks. We are part of the Drug Product Research unit, which is responsible for early injectable and oral formulation development and drug product analyses across the Novo research portfolio. The area houses a broad portfolio of state-of-the-art biophysical instrumentation and automation.

Day to day, you will work alongside scientist and laboratory technician colleagues, sharing ideas across scientific specialisations. You will collaborate closely with colleagues in biology, chemistry and recombinant technologies at Novo, as well as selected external industry and academic partners. Together, you will turn data into clear recommendations that help projects move forward.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will have the trust and autonomy to drive change, within a collaborative culture where your contribution matters. You will work with advanced instrumentation and automation, learn from colleagues across disciplines, and help shape how the department adopts new technologies, digital tools and AI. You will be supported to perform at your best, while being encouraged to make your voice heard and grow with the team.
